_comment: How a Snapchat run CHOOSES and crops its frames, shared by every
channel under the heading because none of them has a reason to differ.
The frames are not composed around anybody. Most of them have no face
in them at all, and the ones that do are not being cropped to put a
person beside a title - the picture is the product, so it is fitted to
the canvas centred and left alone.
min_text_space is zero because it asks how much room is clear BESIDE
the subject for a title to go in, and these titles do not go beside
anybody: the caption lies across the foot of the picture on a card of
its own. No frame should be rejected for failing to leave a column
Named rather than repeated for the reason snapchat-capture is: a pack
under this heading is made by copying its neighbour, and every key
restated in each of them is a key a new channel can be missing.
